definitions.supplemental: Cf. (?) Thyxyl ascia, Prompt. Parv. 491, and see note there. Thyxylle, Wrt. Voc. i. 234, 18. O. H. Ger. dehsa ascia; dehsísen confertorium; dehsala ascia, ferrum confertorium: Icel. þexla an adze.

source_text: þeox a spear :-- Ísenum bársperum &l-bar; þioxum ferratis venabulis, Hpt. Gl. 423, 68. [Cf. (?) Thyxyl ascia, Prompt. Parv. 491, and see note there. Thyxylle, Wrt. Voc. i. 234, 18. O. H. Ger. dehsa ascia; dehsísen confertorium; dehsala ascia, ferrum confertorium: Icel. þexla an adze.]
